# SkyPark agent startup

At the start of every repository session, including read-only inspection and review, read the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) in full and
applicable nested instructions. Follow its Required agent startup checklist,
work identity, PR/review, verification, secrets and handoff requirements.
If you cannot load AGENTS.md, stop before modifying the repository.
Do not replace the shared policy with a separate Copilot rulebook.
